topic: Figma Prototyping and Interactive UI Design
learningObjectives: Identify the core workflow for creating interfaces in Figma.
Connect interface screens into interactive prototypes.
Apply components and reusable design elements to prototype screens.

activities.title: Figma Workspace Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the major areas of a Figma workspace.

content.concept: A Figma workspace provides tools for designing frames, components, layers, prototypes, and collaborative interfaces.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Component System Builder
activities.instruction: Build a reusable component from interface elements.

content.concept: Components allow repeated interface elements to share structure and visual behavior across designs.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Prototype Flow
activities.instruction: Connect screens to create an interactive user flow.

content.concept: Prototyping connects frames and interactions to simulate how users move through an interface.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Interaction Selector
activities.instruction: Choose the appropriate interaction for each UI element.

content.concept: Different interface elements can trigger actions such as navigation, overlays, state changes, or feedback.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
